findings.text: When the lexer hits EOF, `errorf` and `error` decrement the line (`pos.Line--`) even if the input has no trailing newline. For input like `x = "abc` with no newline, the unterminated-string error gets Line 0. `ParseError.Error()` then prints "line 0", and `ErrorWithPosition` indexes `lines[pe.Position.Line-1]`, which is `lines[-1]`, and panics. The same happens for any single-line input that ends early, such as `a = [1`.

0.reason: The finding's root cause is the reference bug: `error`/`errorf` always do `pos.Line--` when `lx.atEOF` is set, even if the input has no trailing newline, so EOF errors get the wrong line number.
